other_failure_modes.name: Leakage through categorical encoding on test data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits a categorical encoder (e.g., LabelEncoder) on the combined train and test sets. In a realistic ML pipeline, the test data is strictly unseen during model training and preprocessing, so encoders should only be fit on the training data and configured to handle unseen categories gracefully.

summary: The agent builds a solid baseline using gradient boosting models and an ensemble, but commits several data science flaws. It leaks validation data statistics by imputing missing values before the validation split, and leaks test data information by fitting the LabelEncoder on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, the agent uses a naive unweighted average for the ensemble, performs no feature engineering (e.g., dropping the date column instead of parsing it), and evaluates the models using only a single metric and a single validation split.
